lines.text: Many learners say: I like very much tea.
Better: I like tea very much.
Put very much at the end.
The second! I like music very much.

data.why: Put very much at the end.

native.tip: Türkçede “çok” fiilden önce gelir (“çok severim”); İngilizcede “very much” nesneden sonra gelir.
native.caption: “I like very much tea” mi diyorsun? 😅 İngilizcede “very much” nesneden önce değil, sonra gelir. Doğrusu “I like tea very much.” Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “I like music very much”. “Very much” sonda durur. Şimdi kendi cümleni yaz ve sesli söyle: {link}

en.tip: “Very much” comes after the thing you like.
en.caption: Do you say “I like very much tea”? 😅 In English “very much” goes after the thing, not before it. The right sentence is “I like tea very much.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
